items.title: Google Adds Grocery Giants to Connected Apps Feature
items.why: Grocers plugging into AI assistants could open future card-linked offer routes worth monitoring.
items.summary_ai: Google's new Connected Apps feature lets users shop grocery chains such as Albertsons, Safeway, Shaw's and Target through Search and Gemini.
items.take: Grocers plugging into AI assistants could open future card-linked offer routes worth monitoring.
